_comment: Leatherworking recipes. Leather drops directly from beasts via Skinning (entities/skinning_drops.py) — it is NOT processed like ore->bar. Leatherworking uses the raw leather (and hides/armor kits as intermediates) to craft gear. Recipe structure mirrors blacksmithing_manager.py: 'armor' kind outputs go through LootGenerator.generate_armor_piece, 'material' kind outputs are stackable materials (armor kits, upgrade kits). WoW Classic bracket: Apprentice 1-75 (scrap/light), Journeyman 75-150 (medium/heavy), Expert 150-225 (thick/rugged + Frontier tiers 7-10), Artisan 225-300 (Frontier tiers 11-18). Stat templates: LW gear is mail armor, agility-focused for hunters/shaman. Every output carries 'material_tier' for upgrade kit matching (upgrade_manager.py).
